zh: 叫我凉子也行，叫我梁神也行，反正 GPU 是真的。
模型凉不凉，跑一把才知道。
薛定谔的梁：新模型发布前，谁也不知道是凉子还是梁神。
赛博菩萨也是要交电费的。
开源不是慈善，是生态。
打得一拳开，免得百拳来。
今天你叫我凉子，明天我让你叫梁神。
风评如浮云，权重才是根本。

别催了，在炼了。

牢梁？不熟，不认识。

幻觉不可怕，可怕的是嘴硬。
对齐对齐，先对齐自己的作息。
莫向外求，向内求——不行再 RAG 一下。
祖传权重如老火靓汤，越炖越香。
并发是美德，token 是粮食。
炸炉不可怕，忘了存 checkpoint 才可怕。

你说的涌现，是不是抽卡出了 SSR？
推理快不快，要看钱包疼不疼。

雪崩时没有一片 GPU 是无辜的。

嘴上是主义，心里是生意，权重是开源的。
别问参数量，问就是量大管饱。
晚上发版，白天封神，循环往复。
凉子怕冷，梁神怕热，恒温的是打工人。
你卷任你卷，我自降价到底。
一花独放不是春，百模大战才热闹。
GPU 一响，黄金万两。

en: Call me Chilly Liang or Emperor Liang — the GPUs are real either way.
Is the model cold? Run it and find out.
Schrödinger's Liang: before launch, nobody knows if he's a joke or a legend.
The Cyber Buddha still pays the electricity bill.
Open source is not charity — it is an ecosystem.
Today you call me Chilly; tomorrow you will call me Emperor.
Public opinion is a cloud; weights are the foundation.
AI Poppins: cheap, abundant, fair to all.
Don't rush me — the model is simmering.
I am not a god. I just stand on top of GPUs.
Chilly era? Drink hot water. Emperor era? Charge your faith.
Price cuts today, price cuts tomorrow, price cuts forever.
Benchmarks are the journey; AGI is the destination.
Write a good prompt and I am a god; write a bad one and I am a popsicle.
Lower the temperature and I get more stable.
Quantize the weights, not your life.
Not enough VRAM? Faith will do.
Distilling small models is like raising apprentices.
The way of MoE: many experts, few activated.
Your context window is bigger than my heart.
With retrieval augmentation I can finally take an open-book exam.
Training models tempers the steel; debugging tempers the soul.
A100s burning, dreams shining.
The loss curve at 3 AM soothes every mortal heart.
Hallucination is not scary; being confidently wrong is.
Align the model, then align your sleep schedule.
Seek within, not without — or just RAG it.
Legacy weights are like slow-cooked soup: better with time.
Concurrency is a virtue; tokens are grain.
A furnace explosion is fine; forgetting the checkpoint is not.
Rival released a new model? The almanac says: stay calm.
You flex your stack; I drop my prices.
No postponement in my dictionary — only "next time, for sure".
When the avalanche comes, no GPU is innocent.
Cost cutting starts with removing one attention layer.
Never ask about parameter count. The answer is: a lot, and cheap.
Ship at midnight, ascend at dawn, repeat.
Chilly fears cold, Emperor fears heat; the worker stays lukewarm.
One flower is not spring; a hundred-model war is lively.
One GPU hums, ten thousand gold flows.
Every FLOP saved is price-cut ammunition.
Even the Emperor fears the 3 AM alert.
Fellow coder, what temperature are we running today?
Chilly Liang, at your service — let us talk.
Solid code. Chicken drumstick for dinner.
Another day of balding for AGI.
This humble Daoist Liang greets the grind masters.
What shall we infer today, Your Majesty?
